title: Bedrock Dupers and Farm Addons
summary: A reference page for the TheySix Bedrock TNT and string duper downloads, addon files, worlds, and tutorial clips.

body.text: These resources are intended for Bedrock and MCPE on consoles, mobile, and Windows 10/11 Edition. Check the world or addon description for compatibility before importing anything into a survival world, and keep a backup before testing a duper.

The TNT Duper download is available as a MediaFire archive. The simple module and single-drop module are provided as separate demonstrations so you can compare the templates with the version of the farm you are building.
